text: Si tawii ko ɓen gomɗimɓe Alla e Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen, ɓe golli golle moƴƴe e hoore no sari'a on yami- yamriri non, arma O Okka ɓe baraaji golle maɓɓe ɗen O Ɓeydana ɓe immorde e Ɓural Makko ngal. Ɓeya townitiiɓe e rewugol Mo ɗoftoo Mo, O Leptay ɓe lepte muusuɗe, ɓe heɓoytaa gaanin Alla, giɗo nafoowo ɓe, wanaa ballo duñanoowo ɓe lorra.
